# C#

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from csharp/lang.json and csharp/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check C# code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- init --apply
```

For a C# project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small C# package from [`csharp/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/csharp/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//csharp:defs.bzl", "csharp_library", "csharp_test")

csharp_library(
    name = "my_project",
    srcs = ["Greet.cs"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)

csharp_test(
    name = "greet_test",
    size = "small",
    srcs = ["GreetTest.cs"],
    deps = [":my_project"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Dependencies

### NuGet packages

List your packages in a `paket.dependencies` file. `dx update --apply` locks
them into `nuget.lock.json`. Then declare the lock in your `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
nuget = use_extension("@rules_dx//csharp:extensions.bzl", "nuget")
nuget.lock(
    name = "nuget",
    lock = "//third_party/dotnet:nuget.lock.json",
)
use_repo(nuget, "nuget")
```

Depend on a package as `@nuget//<lowercase package id>`. `dx update nuget`
moves the pins to newer versions.

`csharp_proto_library` needs Google.Protobuf. Add
`nuget Google.Protobuf 3.37.0-rc3` to `paket.dependencies` and put
`@nuget//google.protobuf` in `deps`.

## Generate

`dx generate` writes `csharp_library`, `csharp_binary` and `csharp_test`
targets from your `.cs` files and their `using` directives. A `using` of a
namespace that a local library declares resolves to that library. Any other
namespace resolves to the package in `paket.lock` named after it, so
`Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` resolves to `newtonsoft.json`.

The `csharp/tests/fixtures/adopt_csharp` tree shows a full run.

## Quality

`csharpier` formats, `roslyn` lints and `csc` typechecks. dx fetches all
three, so you install nothing:

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- format //app/...
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- lint //app/...
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- typecheck //app/...
```

`roslyn` analyzes every framework in a `target_frameworks` list, for the host
runtime only. A finding that only some frameworks report ends with those
frameworks, such as `[net8.0]`. When `target_frameworks` is a `select()`,
only the framework it resolves to is analyzed.

`roslyn` reads a `.globalconfig` bound with `roslyn_config`. Name it
`.globalconfig` and put it at the root: the C# Dev Kit picks it up by that
name, so your editor and `dx` report the same findings. Start from
`standard.globalconfig` or `strict.globalconfig` in
`core/quality/tiers/roslyn/`.

`csc` reports only compiler diagnostics (`CS*`), from the same per-framework
compile that `roslyn` uses, so no extra compile runs. Analyzer findings come
from `roslyn`. See the
[quality config table](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/quality.md).

## Coverage

`bazel coverage` and `dx coverage` run C# tests under coverlet and write LCOV.
They cover the first-party assemblies that match `--instrumentation_filter`.
The test assembly counts only with `--instrument_test_targets`. Tag a test
`no-coverage` to skip it under coverage.

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//csharp:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//csharp:defs.bzl", "csharp_proto_library", "csharp_library", "csharp_binary")
```

### `csharp_proto_library`

```python
csharp_proto_library(name, proto, deps = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Compiles a proto_library to C# with protoc; deps should hold Google.Protobuf.

### `csharp_library`

```python
csharp_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over csharp_library; target_frameworks defaults to net10.0, out defaults to name and warnings are errors.

### `csharp_binary`

```python
csharp_binary(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, upstream_visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Binary with target_frameworks net10.0; warnings as errors follow the repo config.

### `csharp_test`

```python
csharp_test(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Test with target_frameworks net10.0, warnings as errors following the repo config, size small; srcs required.

### `csharp_bench`

```python
csharp_bench(name, *, srcs, deps = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A csharp_test that runs the [Benchmark] classes in srcs with BenchmarkDotNet and writes dx-bench.json.

### `csharp_fuzz_test`

```python
csharp_fuzz_test(name, *, srcs, deps = None, visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A SharpFuzz harness plus a `<name>_run` runner for `dx fuzz`.

### `csharp_doc_shard`

```python
csharp_doc_shard(name, library, package = "", **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one C# library.

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for C#:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `csc`, `csharpier`, `roslyn` |
| Ecosystems | nuget |
| Manifests | `paket.dependencies` |
| Lockfiles | `nuget.lock.json`, `paket.lock` |

## Platforms

C# builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64

See the [support matrix](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/support-matrix.md).

## API docs

`tools/dx docs` builds the API docs with `csharp doc driver`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

To declare a docs target yourself, load the rule behind it:

```python
load("@rules_dx//csharp:defs.bzl", "csharp_doc_shard")
```
